design_gotchas.title: SOT23 (SA) Pinout (1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) Conflicts With SOT23R (SR), AP2210N, and LM3480
design_gotchas.detail: AP7333-33SAG-7 uses the SA (SOT23) pinout: Pin 1=IN, Pin 2=OUT, Pin 3=GND. This is REVERSED on Pins 1 and 3 compared to SOT23R (AP7313-33SRG-7) and AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (Pin 1=GND, Pin 2=OUT, Pin 3=IN), and completely different from TI LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (Pin 1=OUT, Pin 2=IN, Pin 3=GND). Dropping SA onto an SR/AP2210N footprint reverse-biases VIN/GND and destroys the regulator.

design_gotchas.title: Thermal Dissipation Ceiling at 5V-to-3.3V Full 300 mA Load
design_gotchas.detail: At VIN=5.0 V, VOUT=3.3 V, and IOUT=300 mA, power dissipation is 510 mW. With θJA = 207 °C/W on minimum pads, junction temperature rises by ~105.6 °C above ambient, exceeding the 125 °C operating TJ limit (and approaching 140 °C thermal shutdown) whenever TA exceeds ~20 °C unless copper area is expanded or load is derated.

design_gotchas.title: 65 uA Quiescent Current Is ~60x Higher Than Ultra-Low-Iq LDOs
design_gotchas.detail: Although the datasheet advertises low IQ, 55 uA (no load) to 65 uA (full load) typ is roughly 55x higher than XC6206 (~1 uA) and over 2,000x higher than TPS7A02 (25 nA), making AP7333 unsuitable for multi-year coin-cell standby rails despite strong fast-transient performance.

design_gotchas.title: Strict 10 mOhm to 200 mOhm ESR Window & No Enable Pin
design_gotchas.detail: The application note specifies 1 uF to 4.7 uF X5R/X7R ceramic capacitors with 10 mOhm to 200 mOhm ESR; avoid ultra-high-ESR electrolytics (>200 mOhm). As a 3-pin device without an EN pin, output power sequencing must be handled upstream.

typical_use_cases: 5 V USB-to-3.3 V regulated rails for MCUs and wireless modules up to 200-300 mA
Fast load-transient digital/DSP and WLAN card local 3.3 V point-of-load supplies
Compact 3-pin SOT-23-3 power rails requiring 1 uF ceramic cap stability without enable control
Direct candidate upgrade for 150 mA AP7313-33SAG-7 footprints needing 300 mA output current
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP7333-33SAG-7 is a 300 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2%) CMOS low-dropout regulator in a 3-pin SOT-23-3 (SA) package with 1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND pinout. It operates from 2 V to 6 V (7 V abs max), features 300 mV typical dropout at 300 mA, 55 uA no-load / 65 uA full-load quiescent current, 65 dB PSRR at 100 Hz, and stability with a 1 uF X5R/X7R ceramic output capacitor (10–200 mOhm ESR). Engineers must carefully distinguish the SA pinout (1=IN, 3=GND) from reversed SOT23R/AP2210N (1=GND, 3=IN) and LM3480 (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND) layouts, and account for its 207 °C/W θJA when running near 300 mA from a 5 V rail.
